steps.title: Premix beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of AMPure beads at a 15–20× concentration and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add beads to sample and mix
steps.instruction: Add 90 µL of the premixed beads to the tube containing 50 µL of sample, then mix at a total volume of 110 µL by pipetting 7–10 times.

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect beads on magnet
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic stand and allow beads to collect for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, remove 140 µL of supernatant into waste, ensuring the tip reaches the bottom of the well; repeat if necessary.

steps.title: Perform ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to the beads twice, using the same tip and dispensing from the top of the well each time.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to air‑dry for 2–3 minutes (do not let them over‑dry).

steps.title: Remove from magnet
steps.instruction: Take the tube off the magnetic stand.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in elution buffer
steps.instruction: Add elution buffer (EB) to the beads, then mix by pipetting up and down 20 times, aspirating low and dispensing high using the default flow rate.

substeps.instruction: Mix 20 times, aspirate low, dispense high

steps.title: Incubate eluate
steps.instruction: Incubate the resuspended beads for 2 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect eluate on magnet
steps.instruction: Place the tube back on the magnetic stand to separate beads from the eluate.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to PCR strip
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of the supernatant (eluate) to a PCR strip tube plate.
